subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the characteristic of particles of the matter?

options.text: They are very large in size.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They are very large in size.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Particles of matter are extremely small** and are beyond the resolution of a standard microscope.
 
• They are in a state of **continuous motion** due to their kinetic energy, which varies with temperature.
 
• There is always **space between particles** of matter, which is evident from the diffusion of gases and mixing of liquids.
 
• Particles of matter **attract each other** with forces that vary depending on the type of matter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brownian Motion:**

 
 
• It is the random movement of particles suspended in a fluid, resulting from their collision with quick atoms or molecules in the gas or liquid.
 
• This phenomenon supports the theory that particles are in continuous motion.
 
 
 
• **Diffusion:**
 
 
• It is the process by which particles spread from an area of high concentration to an area of low concentration.
 
• Diffusion demonstrates that particles have space between them and are constantly moving.
 
 
 
• **Intermolecular Forces:**
 
 
• These are forces of attraction or repulsion which act between neighboring particles (atoms, molecules, or ions).
 
• Examples include hydrogen bonds, Van der Waals forces, and ionic bonds.
 
 
 
• **Kinetic Theory of Matter:**
 
 
• This theory states that matter is composed of a large number of small particles that are in constant motion.
 
• The temperature of a substance is a measure of the average kinetic energy of its particles.
